label: coach_paldea_botan_first_01
text: Is this your clubroom? Hope so, since I came to\nraid it![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp01_00
text: Blueberry Academy is, like, unreal. I can’t believe\nyou get to study here![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp01_01
text: But, uh, there sure are a lot of people in this\nroom I don’t know...\c\nMakes me kinda nervous...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp01_select_01
text: Aw, you’ll be fine!

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp01_select_02
text: Push past the nerves!

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp01_02
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Um, yeah... I dunno...\c\nNot everyone can be as outgoing as you,\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp01_03
text: I guess I can try toughing it out a little longer if\nI think of this as extrovert practice...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp01_04
text: Just don’t leave me alone for too long, OK?\nNew places are a lot for me to deal with.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp02_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hey, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Do you have
any
idea
how
amazing
this
academy
really is?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp02_select_01
text: I sure do!

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp02_select_02
text: How do you mean?

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp02_01
text: Really?! Is Blueberry Academy famous enough\nthat everyone knows all about it?\c\nWell, let me tell you what I found out anyway.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp02_01b
text: Oh, you didn’t know? I did some digging since I\nwas curious, and I found out some cool stuff...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp02_02
text: The academy has this resource development\nplant on one of its lower levels, way down on\r\nthe seabed.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp02_03
text: They do all sorts of marine research down there,\nand they survey the seabed for resources, too![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp02_04
text: I heard students aren’t allowed to visit though,\nwhich I guess isn’t all that surprising...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp02_05
text: But to think that cutting-edge science is going on\nbelow us right now...it’s like some kind of dream![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_00
text: [VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Ah, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]! Something big\nhappened![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_select_01
text: Tell me all about it!

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_select_02
text: I’m not interested...

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_01
text: Yesss! I knew you’d wanna hear! I’m still buzzing\nfrom the excitement![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_01b
text: Huh? That’s not a very “you” thing to say! But\nit won’t take long, so I’ll just tell you![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_02
text: Remember the resource development plant I\nmentioned? The one beneath the academy?!\r\nI got to go inside! It was incredible![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_03
text: So, I’m at Blueberry’s entrance, having a look\naround, right?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_04
text: Then this dapper old guy in a white suit shows up\nand tells me he’ll take me to the plant if I want![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_05
text:
He had, like, this amazingly cheerful, impish air
about him. I wonder what his deal was...\c
It almost felt like he was one of the feyfolk
disguised as an old guy![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_select_03
text: You might be right!

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_select_04
text: That’s the director...

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_06
text:
Oh, you think so too? Yeah, he had a real special
aura... I’m sure that must be it!\c
I’ll keep looking into this dapper fey fellow and
find out who he really is![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_sp03_06b
text:
What?! That dapper guy’s the DIRECTOR?\c
Is it some kinda requirement for academy
directors to be eccentrics or something?!
I mean, first Director Clavell and now him?![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_trade_01_00
text: Blueberry Academy really is incredible.\c\nI wasn’t sure about accepting your invite at first,\nbut I’m glad I did![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_trade_01_01
text: Don’t think of this as, like, a thank-you gift for\ninviting me or anything...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_trade_01_02
text: but do you wanna trade Pokémon with me?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_trade_01_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Nice! I’ll offer up a Veevee from my end, of
course. I’ve got a real feisty one just for you!\c
Which Pokémon will you go for,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_trade_01_04
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)][VAR 0x0101(0001)], huh... This Pokémon’s so
you.
I’ll
treasure
it
forever![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_trade_02_00
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]OK! So we’ll go ahead and trade your
[VAR 0x0101(0001)]
for
my
Veevee,
right?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_trade_02_01
text: You can’t trade Penny a Pokémon if you aren’t its\noriginal Trainer!

label: coach_paldea_botan_trade_02_02
text: You can’t trade Penny such a rare Pokémon!

label: coach_paldea_botan_trade_02_03
text: You can’t trade Penny a Shiny Pokémon!

label: coach_paldea_botan_trade_03_00
text: Wait...we can’t trade if there’s only one Pokémon\nin your party. You need at least two, OK?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_trade_03_01
text: Oh, you don’t want to trade just yet? OK, well,\nmy Veevee and I will wait right here for you.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_trade_04_00
text: Are you ready to trade Pokémon now?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_talkto_00
text: Ooh, from that glint in your eye I’m guessing\nyou wanna raid—er, I mean battle! Am I right?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_cancel_00
text: Aw. I thought I recognized that little sparkle of\nyours, but guess I was off.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_battlestart_00
text: If someone challenges me to a battle, you know\nI’ve got no choice but to accept![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_gym_kusa_battlestart_01
text: [EMPTY 60]

label: coach_paldea_botan_battleend_win_00_00
text: Geeeeeez, how do you keep beating all my\nVeevees anyway? I don’t get it...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_battleend_win_00_01
text: But you know...I’m so glad I got to meet you.\c\nI never thought I’d get this close with anyone\nelse, like I did with my friends in Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_battleend_win_00_02
text: Ah, sorry! That came out of nowhere, didn’t it?\nI, err...I just felt the need to say it.\c\nAnyway. Here! For you![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_battleend_win_00_03
text: So, er, that wraps that up! Hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_reward_00
text: [EMPTY 60]

label: coach_paldea_botan_battleend_win_01_00
text: I can’t believe you’re the Veevee victor again!\nMy energy levels are getting seriously depleted...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_battleend_win_01_01
text: Welp, till next time, then. Hasta la vistar! ☆[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_battleend_lose_00_00
text: Hehe. Did you expect any less from the big boss\nof Team Star? My Veevees reign supreme![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_randomtalk_00
text:
The Terarium sure is something else. It’s easy to
forget you’re actually indoors when the dome
looks just like the sky.\c
How do they do that anyway?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_randomtalk_01
text:
You know how Squawkabilly are used to ferry the
Flying Taxis around back in Paldea?\c
Well, where I’m from we use Corviknight—and in
the Terarium, it’s yet another different Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_randomtalk_02
text:
Thanks again for inviting me to visit all these
places with you.\c
It’s not the easiest thing for a former shut-in like
me to do, but...I always end up having fun.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_randomtalk_03
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]The [VAR 0x0101(0001)] you traded me is getting
on
great
with
my
Veevees![VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: coach_paldea_botan_randomtalk_04
text:
How’s my feisty li’l Veevee doing?\c
You can have him evolve any way you like, or you
can have him stay an Eevee forever!\c
That’s what makes Eevee so great.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
